primary_title: Serotonin 5-HT7 receptors coupled to induction of interleukin-6 in human microglial MC-3 cells
decision_basis: Primary 5-HT7 pharmacology supports increased measured cAMP accumulation in human MC-3 microglia.
limitations_preserved: Preserve agonist, SB-269970 antagonist, human MC-3 cell-line and splice-variant context; cAMP is a measured second-messenger output and no downstream transcriptional or terminal-TF inference is added.

primary_title: Serotonin 5-HT7 receptors coupled to induction of interleukin-6 in human microglial MC-3 cells
decision_basis: Primary 5-HT7 pharmacology supports increased measured microglial IL-6 mRNA after 5-CT, blocked by SB-269970.
limitations_preserved: Preserve transcript-level IL-6, antagonist and cell-line context; no IL-6 protein-release, secretion or terminal-TF inference is added.

primary_title: Activation of serotonin receptors promotes microglial injury-induced motility but attenuates phagocytic activity
decision_basis: Primary serotonin exposure increased measured microglial process movement toward cortical laser lesions and ATP chemotaxis.
limitations_preserved: Preserve multi-receptor and mouse slice/culture context; receptor subtype is not isolated and no traumatic-SCI or terminal-TF inference is added.

primary_title: Activation of serotonin receptors promotes microglial injury-induced motility but attenuates phagocytic activity
decision_basis: Primary serotonin exposure reduced measured microsphere uptake by amoeboid and cultured microglia, with no significant effect in ramified microglia in situ.
limitations_preserved: Preserve cell-state-dependent, multi-receptor and mouse slice/culture context; no exclusive HTR7 attribution or traumatic-SCI/terminal-TF inference is added.
